verdict.rationale: Oneleet's evidence only documents the reverse direction: an official Oneleet MCP server that external AI assistants connect to, using OAuth or service keys. Nothing shows Oneleet itself, including its Fieldwork AI agents, acting as an MCP client that can register third-party MCP servers and call their tools. Server-side MCP evidence does not transfer to this client-side story, and since an agentic compliance platform could plausibly ship this, the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
